general.explanation: Four single-color cells exclude all nontrivial rotations except180. Fixed-edge and fixed-tile obstructions exclude every strong reflection. Thus a strong coloring has exactly identity and halfturn/color-swap in its stabilizer. At most one weak axis of each type is possible; coexistence forces their perpendicular pair and a weak halfturn.

selectors.claim: Every valid colored mono geometry has exactly two canonicalizing group elements, for every assignment of the selector colors. Strong halfturn stabilizer2 gives one representative; trivial strong stabilizer gives two. For the TB mode, the residual group has32 elements and only the261 special strong-rotation cases have stabilizer2.
